pages.title: Asthma
pages.extract:
Asthma is a long-term inflammatory disease of the airways of the lungs.

== Signs and symptoms ==

Wheezing, coughing and shortness of breath are common.



Symptoms are usually worse at night.

pages.title: Malaria
pages.extract:
Malaria is a mosquito-borne infectious disease.

== Cause ==

It is caused by single-celled parasites of the Plasmodium group.
